name: std::ranges::slide_view<V>::iterator<Const>::operator*
intro:
Returns the current element in the slide_view.

Let current_ and n_ be the underlying data members. Equivalent to: return views::counted(current_, n_).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The current element, which is an object of value_type.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a slide_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns the current element in the slide_view.
